items.title: Premium push, asset-light model to help Lemon Tree maintain growth momentum
items.description: Lemon Tree Hotels has shown impressive growth in both revenue and net profit for the latest quarter ending in September. The firm is focusing on an asset-light management strategy and expanding its premium Aurika portfolio with new properties that promise great future profitability. Analysts are bullish, forecasting stock target prices well above current levels, driven by anticipated positive trends.
